study: M5 H2 frozen-rule replication, seed robustness

seed_source.rule: canonical first, then the repository convention, extended by one only to reach three; no invented values

training_population: Stage A M5 1200, identical for every seed

training.checkpoint_rule: validation MSE of the final mean prediction, identical for every DLinear variant
training.hyperparameter_rule: no per-cell tuning; one setting for every cell and every model; TSB alpha/beta chosen on a fixed grid using the validation split only

aggregate_rule: average delta_relative across seeds per series, then bootstrap over series; seeds are not extra series

bootstrap.note: time rows are never resampled as if independent

verdict_rule.H2_SEED_ROBUST: every seed effect < 0 and aggregate < 0 with CI excluding 0
verdict_rule.H2_SEED_DIRECTION_STABLE: at least 2/3 seeds < 0 and aggregate < 0 but CI covers 0
verdict_rule.H2_SEED_UNSTABLE: aggregate >= 0 or the sign flips repeatedly
